import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(2 * n + 1)] for __ in range(2 * n + 1)]
    dp[0][0][0] = 1
    for depth in range(1, 2 * n + 1):
        for opened in range(depth % 2, depth + 1, 2):
            if opened - 1 >= 0:
                dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1]) % MOD
                dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0]) % MOD
            if opened + 1 < len(dp[depth - 1]):
                dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1]) % MOD
                dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0]) % MOD
            dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + 1) % MOD
            dp[depth][opened][1] %= MOD
    ans = dp[2 * n][0][1]
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
